facts.fact: The deal record reports that the Journal officiel of 30 October 2025, ratifying the EIB loan and EU grant, sets out a EUR 135 million financing table (World Bank 94.6, EIB loan 26, EU grants 10.3 and 4.1) and names a World Bank-financed component modernising the civil status register with the preconditions for an inclusive digital identification framework; no domestic budget line is stated.

systems.system: état-civil register (modernisation component of the digital transformation acceleration project)
IT interoperability framework and data exchange platform
systems.tiers: not stated; no link to the civil register is described
